title: Talk to your CRM with AI 🤯 Bigin by Zoho CRM spots hot deals, flags leads, writes replies
description:
A CRM you can literally talk to with AI 🤯
Comment “CRM” and I’ll send you the link.

Bigin by Zoho CRM connects to Claude and turns from a “dead database” into an active assistant: it tells you which deals need attention, flags leads without follow-ups, and even writes messages for you.

Built-in AI, fast setup, no credit card required — and it keeps getting smarter.
If you’re exploring AI tools, this is a must-try. #shorts
